about:
# Tutti

![Tutti: every group loot roll in one calm window](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/creazy231/Tutti/main/docs/listing/screenshots/hero.png)

**Every group loot roll in one calm window, drawn in the EllesmereUI look.**
When an item drops in your group, Tutti opens by itself and shows who picked Need, Greed or
Pass, everyone's roll and who won. You roll in the same window. On every game version. In
music, *tutti* is the passage where the whole orchestra plays together; here it is the
whole group's rolls in one window.

![A boss drop in Tutti: the picks come in, the numbers spin, the winners get their crowns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/creazy231/Tutti/main/docs/listing/animations/01-a-boss-drop.gif)

## What it does

- **Opens by itself.** When a group roll starts, every item gets a card: the icon with its
  quality edge, the name in its quality colour, the item's type and level ("Two-Hand Axe ·
  ilvl 33"), the seconds left and a countdown bar. The whole group is listed under it, in
  the order of the party frames.
- **Everyone's pick.** Class icon, name in the class colour, then the pick: Need (a green
  die), Greed (an amber coin), Transmog (purple) or Pass (grey, and the row dims), or three
  pulsing dots while someone is still choosing. The roll number spins in when it arrives.
- **Roll right there.** A card that waits on you has an accent edge and buttons for Need,
  Greed and Pass (Transmog in place of Greed when the game offers it). If you can't Need an
  item, that button is greyed out with the game's reason. Your pick shows in your row at
  once. Until you pick, the card stays in sight: the window scrolls to it when the cards
  change, nothing moves under the mouse right after your click, the close button stays
  hidden, and from Recent rolls or Settings the count in the header (in the accent colour)
  leads back to it; 10 seconds before the roll ends the window goes back by itself.
  Soulbound items still get Blizzard's own confirmation: Tutti never confirms for you.
- **A clear winner.** The winner's row lights up in the accent colour and gets a crown, its
  number turns accent-coloured and the other rows fade back. The subtitle reads "Name won ·
  Need 19". When you win, the item icon glows, a light sweeps the card and a soft chime
  plays (unless you turn it off). If everyone passed, the card says so; a tie shows both
  numbers.
- **Tidies itself up.** A decided card stays whole for about 4 seconds, then folds into one
  line under "Done" while other cards are still open. About 10 seconds after the last roll
  is decided the window closes itself. It waits while the mouse is over it, and a new roll
  cancels the countdown.
- **Recent rolls.** The session's results (up to 100), grouped by instance or zone and day,
  one click away: the clock in the window's header, the addon compartment (the minimap's
  addon menu) or `/tutti`. Click a line to see everyone's picks. They survive `/reload` and
  are cleared at login.
- **Raids too.** In a raid a card lists only the members who picked Need, Greed or
  Transmog, the winner, and you. Everyone else folds into one line ("13 passed · 2
  choosing") that opens. A long list of cards scrolls inside the window once it would pass
  about 70 % of the screen's height.
- **Items as usual.** On a card, hover the icon or the name for the item tooltip,
  shift-click to link it in chat, ctrl-click for the dressing room. With NaowhForever_BiS,
  its BiS badge shows on a card for an item it ranks for you.
- **Matches your UI.** With EllesmereUI it follows your panel colour and font live, and the
  accent is your class colour or EllesmereUI's. Without EllesmereUI it uses the same palette
  and the game font, with your class colour.

## Commands

| | |
|---|---|
| `/tutti` | open or close Recent rolls |
| `/tutti settings` | open the settings |
| `/tutti demo` | play a boss drop with no real rolls, to see the window at work (with your group's names when you are in one) |

The clock in the window's header and the addon compartment open Recent rolls too. Drag the
header to move the window; its position is saved. There is no minimap button.

## Settings

The gear in the window's header. Changes apply at once.

Roll in Tutti (Need, Greed and Pass on each card, Blizzard's roll popups hidden) · close
after the last roll (5, 10, 20 or 30 seconds, or never) · sound when you win (soft chime or
none) · accent (class colour or EllesmereUI's, with EllesmereUI) · scale (50 to 200 %; the
window and its menus).

Turning "Roll in Tutti" on takes effect at once. Turning it off brings Blizzard's popups
back after a `/reload`; the setting says so and offers a Reload button. Until then the cards
keep their buttons; after it you roll in Blizzard's popups and the cards show the group.

## Compatibility

Every game version: Retail, Classic Era, TBC Anniversary, Wrath (and Titan-Reforged), Cataclysm and Mists of Pandaria Classic, and WoW Forever. One TOC lists them all
(`## Interface: 120105, 120107, 50504, 40402, 38002, 30405, 20506, 16001, 11509`).
Retail and WoW Forever read the newer loot history; the Classic clients read their own,
older one, and offer Need, Greed and Pass (no Transmog there). The addon compartment
exists on Retail and WoW Forever; elsewhere `/tutti` opens Recent rolls. EllesmereUI,
NaowhForever_BiS (WoW Forever) and Polestar are optional.

## Good to know

- **Blizzard's roll popups are replaced.** While "Roll in Tutti" is on, Tutti switches them
  off (the way ElvUI does). After a `/reload` in the middle of a roll, Blizzard's popups for
  the rolls still open show up next to Tutti's cards, once.
- **Gamepad interface.** With the gamepad interface on, Tutti steps aside and Blizzard's own
  gamepad roll frame takes the rolls: no roll opens Tutti's window, and switching to the
  gamepad interface closes it. Switching back in the middle of a roll, Blizzard's popup for
  that roll may show next to Tutti's card, once.
- **EllesmereUI is optional.** With the popups hidden, EllesmereUI's loot-roll skin and its
  "Group Loot" mover have nothing to act on, which is harmless.
- **Polestar.** Its note about a quest item a party member still needs sits under Tutti's
  window while both show.
- **Group loot only.** With free-for-all, master loot or personal loot nothing opens. A
  roll you are not part of still gets a card, without buttons, and a member who is out of
  range or dead shows "not in this roll".

## Development

The addon is plain Lua with no libraries. An offline suite runs it inside a fake WoW Forever
client:

```sh
luajit tests/run.lua && luajit tests/syntax.lua
python3 -I tests/test_media.py   # needs Pillow
```

Media is generated: `python3 -I tools/make_media.py .` (Pillow) and
`python3 -I tools/make_sound.py .` (ffmpeg). `luajit tools/render_ui.lua` draws the window
from the fake client as a web page, to check the look without the game;
`tools/make_listing.py` and `tools/make_gifs.py` make the CurseForge gallery and the
animations above from it. The design is in
[docs/design.md](https://github.com/creazy231/Tutti/blob/main/docs/design.md). Releases: see [docs/RELEASING.md](https://github.com/creazy231/Tutti/blob/main/docs/RELEASING.md). When
Forever is patched, its new interface number goes into `## Interface` in `Tutti.toc`.

# Changelog

## 1.0.0

First release.

- Every group loot roll in one window that opens by itself: one card per item (icon, name,
  type and level, seconds left, a countdown bar) with the whole group listed under it in the
  order of the party frames.
- Everyone's pick (Need, Greed, Transmog, Pass, or three dots while someone is still
  choosing) from the game's loot history, with the roll numbers spinning in as they arrive.
- The winner's row lights up with a crown and the others fade back. When you win, the item
  glows, a light sweeps the card and a soft chime plays. Ties show both numbers, and a roll
  everyone passed says so.
- Roll from the card: Need, Greed (Transmog when the game offers it) and Pass. A Need you
  can't make is greyed out with the game's reason. Blizzard's roll popups stay hidden while
  "Roll in Tutti" is on; soulbound items still get Blizzard's own confirmation. With it off
  you roll in Blizzard's popups and the cards show the group without buttons.
- With WoW Forever's gamepad interface on, Tutti steps aside and Blizzard's gamepad roll
  frame takes the rolls: no roll opens Tutti's window there, and switching to the gamepad
  interface closes it. Back with mouse and keyboard, a roll still waiting on you brings
  Tutti back.
- A card that waits on you stays in sight: the window scrolls it into view whenever the
  cards change, nothing moves under the mouse right after your pick, and nothing folds
  under it while a card waits. In Recent rolls or Settings the count in the header shows the
  waiting card in the accent colour and leads back, and the window goes back to the rolls by
  itself 10 seconds before such a roll ends.
- Decided items fold into one line under "Done" while others are still open. The window
  closes itself after the last roll (5, 10, 20 or 30 seconds, or never), waits while the
  mouse is over it, and a new roll cancels the countdown.
- Recent rolls: the session's results (up to 100) by instance or zone and day, with
  everyone's picks one click away. Opened from the clock in the header, the addon
  compartment or `/tutti`; kept through `/reload`, cleared at login. The demo's results
  are marked "DEMO".
- A stack of an item shows its count on the item's icon, on the card and in Recent rolls.
- Raids: a card lists only the members who picked Need, Greed or Transmog, the winner and
  you, and folds everyone else into one line ("13 passed · 2 choosing") that opens.
- Item tooltips on hover, shift-click to link, ctrl-click for the dressing room. A BiS badge
  on the cards of items NaowhForever_BiS ranks for you. Polestar's note about a party
  member's quest item sits under the window.
- Settings in the window (the gear): Roll in Tutti, close after the last roll, sound when
  you win, accent (class colour or EllesmereUI's) and scale (50 to 200 %, the window and
  its menus). `/tutti`, `/tutti settings` and `/tutti demo`.
- Follows EllesmereUI's panel colour and font live; class colour accent by default. Works
  without EllesmereUI.
- Every game version: Retail, Classic Era, TBC Anniversary, Wrath (and Titan-Reforged),
  Cataclysm and Mists of Pandaria Classic, and WoW Forever. The Classic clients offer Need,
  Greed and Pass, and open Recent rolls with `/tutti` (they have no addon compartment).
